title: App keys get clearer attribution and fewer setup requirements
summary:
App keys got simpler to set up, BYOP attribution got more reliable, and the community app listings got a tidy-up.

BYOP generation events can now resolve the app name and owner from the associated publishable key. Publishable app keys can also be created and edited without a redirect URI, while the key list shows when an app has multiple redirect URIs.

An automated catalog refresh raised the App Greenhouse count from 707 to 709 and updated health-check results. A separate correction credited the Obsidian chat app to its submitter and removed a listing whose URL no longer hosts the app.

The README’s Latest News and Recent Apps sections were refreshed. Recent Apps now shows contributors’ GitHub handles instead of generic attribution.

daily.title: App keys without redirects
daily.text: Create and edit publishable app keys without adding a redirect URI. [Manage API keys](https://enter.pollinations.ai/keys).
